description: This bar chart illustrates the values of γ for different values of 0 through 4. The horizontal axis represents the values 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4, listed in ascending order, while the vertical axis is labeled “γ” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. There are five maroon-colored bars, each corresponding to one of the values on the horizontal axis. The bar for value 0 reaches approximately 0.52, while the bar for value 1 reaches approximately 0.22. The bar for value 2 reaches approximately 0.12, the bar for value 3 reaches approximately 0.06, and the bar for value 4 reaches approximately 0.03.  Each bar is patterned with small blue dots. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
